items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Sandbox premise commands before executing them**

When the consistency checker runs at acceptance on a PR-controlled task file, any premise reaches `bash -c` here with the review user's permissions. Restricting `PATH` does not prevent shell builtins, absolute executables, redirects, or destructive repository writes, so the checker described as read-only can execute arbitrary code before deciding whether the task is valid; the threat table's claim that the checker stays read-only therefore does not mitigate this boundary. Run premises in a genuinely read-only sandbox or require them to come from a trusted revision.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L75-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/35c660222ffd7af143842d310ae8cf3b15db61c5/AGENTS.md#L75-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bundle the required task template**

In the reviewed commit tree, a repo-wide tree search finds no `.orchestration/tasks/dotfiles-T133-result-precheck-a01.md`, but every generator invocation unconditionally reads that path here. Consequently a clean checkout raises `FileNotFoundError` before writing a task; the closed test masks this because its fixture creates the missing template itself. Include a stable template in the repository or generate these rows without depending on an untracked task file.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L75-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/35c660222ffd7af143842d310ae8cf3b15db61c5/AGENTS.md#L75-L78)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve globs before checking wave overlaps**

When one same-wave task allows `scripts/*.py` and another allows `scripts/foo.py`, this normalization leaves the first value as the literal string `scripts/*.py`; the later equality/prefix comparison therefore reports no F2 violation even though both tasks can edit `scripts/foo.py`. Expand tracked matches or perform real glob-overlap checks before comparing scopes; the current closed test covers only two identical concrete paths.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L75-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/35c660222ffd7af143842d310ae8cf3b15db61c5/AGENTS.md#L75-L78)
